svg.title: Guard, act, verify
svg.desc: A tree for one plan step. At the top, a Sequence with memory. Under it, four leaves from left to right: guard (blue), act (red), verify (blue) and update (green). Below the act and verify leaves is a box labeled skills package and ARIAC; along the bottom is a box labeled blackboard, the executor's facts. Tag 1: an arrow from the blackboard up to the guard. Tag 2: an arrow from the act down to the skills box, and one back up. Tag 3: an arrow from the skills box up to the verify. Tag 4: an arrow from the update down to the blackboard.
